name: TagTrack
description: TagTrack (v2.0.16) is the #1 phygital NFC & QR habit and routine tracker for iPhone. Validate single habits or 1-Tap Multi-Habit Routines (+25 XP) in under 2 seconds by touching real objects, sync bidirectionally with Apple Health (Water mL, Steps, Sleep, Workouts, Mindfulness), and protect streaks with automatic Streak Shield.
